dataset: TitrateLab vendor-blind peptide lab corpus snapshot
scope: Published records resolved to a recognized canonical peptide or peptide blend, aggregated by compound. Compounds below the minimum cell size are omitted.
exclusions: No vendor, manufacturer, client, submitter, batch, or certificate identity is included.
Unpublished records, non-peptide analytical work, and rows without a recognized canonical peptide name are excluded.
Dose figures use deviation from the printed label; deviation from a separate batch claim is not substituted.
A test record is not a random market sample and does not establish product safety or suitability.
Laboratory labels are the names printed on public reports; laboratories below the cell floor are reported as 'Other labs' and Finnrick's anonymized panel laboratories as one group.

totals.certificate_identifier_key: Distinct values of COALESCE(verify_url, lab_name:test_id) over all published entries. The projection carries no file hashes, so this is an upper bound on distinct certificates: a certificate published twice without a verification URL and under two test ids counts twice.

lab_dimension.service_name_rule: A report printed with the service name 'Finnrick' as its laboratory is counted with the Finnrick panel group.
lab_dimension.finnrick_panel_rule: Finnrick reports name their panel laboratories as 'Lab A' to 'Lab N'; those records are reported together as 'Finnrick panel labs (anonymized)'.

data_dictionary.test_records: Published lab-report entries in the cell after canonical-name resolution.
data_dictionary.purity_results: Records with a reported purity greater than zero.
data_dictionary.zero_identity_results: Records reported at zero purity or with no identified target compound.
data_dictionary.mean_purity_pct: Arithmetic mean of purity_results, in percent.
data_dictionary.quantity_results: Records with tested quantity expressed as percent deviation from the printed label.
data_dictionary.quantity_within_10pct_pct: Share of quantity results within plus or minus 10% of the printed label.
data_dictionary.quantity_more_than_10pct_under_label: Quantity results more than 10% below the printed label.
data_dictionary.endotoxin_results: Records carrying any endotoxin result, including 'below detection' outcomes.
data_dictionary.verifiable_records: Records carrying a laboratory verification URL.
data_dictionary.month: Calendar month of the test date printed on the report (YYYY-MM).
data_dictionary.lab: Laboratory label as printed on the public report, after the alias and floor rules in lab_dimension.
data_dictionary.profile_url: TitrateLab laboratory profile when one is published; blank otherwise.
